//: For packages compiled by tsc and consumed by a bundler (Next, Vite, Storybook).
Keeps verbatimModuleSyntax: true from base — there is no decorator metadata here,
so type-only imports are safe and desirable.
Named library.json, not package.json: a tsconfig called package.json is read as a
manifest by pnpm, IDEs, and anything that walks the tree looking for one.
